sources.title: torch-pointcloud (PyTorch PointCloud) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PyTorch PointCloud (torch-pointcloud) is a collection of point cloud models, layers, utilities, datasets, transforms, and reference training / benchmarking scripts that aim to reproduce SOTA models and help researchers and engineers reuse common layers.
